items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Bob Chester was also -- he's from Detroit, he had a band later on.

ctx.x: He didn't come till later. He's very good. These were guys that were playing jobs around Detroit. There was another guy that played there, he wasn't in that band, but I wouldn't be at all surprised.

Also, I think they called them the Orange Blossoms at that time and they played also, opposite the band, the relief band in the Grays tone. That was one of their jobs and Bob Chester was also -- he's from Detroit, he had a band later on.
